name: 4x4 bouldering
description: A power endurance block on the bouldering wall: four problems, each climbed four times in a row with almost no rest between laps. It trains you to keep pulling hard while your forearms are pumped.
instructions: Warm up fully, then choose four problems of 8 to 12 moves that are well within your ability and have no hard crux.
Climb the first problem, step down and get straight back on it.
Do four laps of that problem back to back. That is one set.
Rest about 3 minutes, then do the same with the next problem.
Finish once all four problems have had their four laps.
Stop a set early if your technique breaks down, and pick easier problems next time.
